headlines.title: الدفاع المدني ينتشل جثامين 7 شهداء في حي الزيتون
headlines.snippet: Civil defense teams recovered the bodies of seven martyrs in the Zeitoun neighborhood. This recovery is part of ongoing efforts following recent events.

headlines.snippet: Occupation forces reportedly destroyed vehicles in front of a car parts shop south of Hebron. This action is part of the ongoing conflict and control measures.

headlines.snippet: Sharp and unprecedented statements have been made by major supporters of Israel regarding the settlers. This indicates growing criticism of settler actions.

headlines.title: UN condemns Israeli strikes on Syria’s Abu al-Duhur airbase - سانا
headlines.snippet: The UN has condemned Israeli strikes on Syria’s Abu al-Duhur airbase. The condemnation was reported by SANA.

headlines.title: Syria condemns Israeli strikes on Abu al-Duhur airbase - سانا
headlines.snippet: Syria has condemned the Israeli strikes on Abu al-Duhur airbase. This condemnation was issued by Syria and reported by SANA.

headlines.title: Syria condemns Israeli strikes on Abu al-Duhur airport in letters to UN - سانا
headlines.snippet: Syria has formally condemned Israeli strikes on Abu al-Duhur airport by sending letters to the UN. The condemnations were reported by SANA.

headlines.title: Arab League condemns Israeli strikes on Syria’s Abu al-Duhur airport - سانا
headlines.snippet: The Arab League has condemned the Israeli strikes targeting Syria’s Abu al-Duhur airport. The condemnation was reported by SANA.

headlines.title: Six killed, several others wounded in Israeli strike on Gaza City port - سانا
headlines.snippet: Six individuals were killed and several others wounded in an Israeli strike on Gaza City port. The attack occurred in the Gaza Strip and was reported by SANA.

headlines.title: Syria’s wells run dry, old grievances run deep
headlines.snippet: Syria's wells are running dry, and old grievances are resurfacing due to a water dispute outside Damascus. This issue is testing the new authorities as shortages and local demands collide.

headlines.title: Hormuz will not open until US meets demands, Iran negotiator Qalibaf says
headlines.snippet: Iran negotiator Ghalibaf stated that the Strait of Hormuz will not open until the U.S. meets its demands. This declaration reiterates Iran's position on the vital waterway.

headlines.title: Palestinian American returns to West Bank to defend his home under siege by Israeli settlers
headlines.snippet: A Palestinian American has returned to the West Bank to defend his home, which is under siege by Israeli settlers. This action highlights the ongoing tensions in the region.

headlines.title: Trump says no Iran talks planned, claims Hormuz ‘new US territory’
headlines.snippet: Trump stated that no talks with Iran are currently planned and claimed the Strait of Hormuz is 'new US territory.' This declaration indicates a firm stance against negotiations.

headlines.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, crew casualty reported, UKMTO says
headlines.snippet: A vessel in the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile, resulting in a crew casualty, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations. The incident raises concerns about maritime security.

headlines.title: Trump envoy discusses Gaza plan with Netanyahu after rare Hamas meeting
headlines.snippet: Trump's envoy discussed the Gaza plan with Netanyahu following a rare meeting with Hamas. These discussions aim to address the ongoing situation in Gaza.

headlines.title: Pakistan top court orders ex-PM Imran Khan moved to hospital
headlines.snippet: Pakistan's top court has ordered that ex-PM Imran Khan be moved to a hospital. This directive follows legal proceedings concerning his health.

headlines.title: In Meta's trial, families of social media victims see a pivotal moment for online safety
headlines.snippet: In Meta's trial, families of social media victims view the ongoing proceedings as a pivotal moment for online safety. The trial focuses on addiction and its impact.

headlines.title: UAE suspends all trade and financial transactions with Iran until further notice
headlines.snippet: The UAE has suspended all trade and financial transactions with Iran until further notice. This decision represents a significant escalation of economic sanctions.

headlines.title: Strait of Hormuz: Bulk carrier hit by unknown projectile, crew casualty reported
headlines.snippet: A bulk carrier in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an unknown projectile, and a crew casualty has been reported. The incident occurred in the vital shipping lane.

headlines.title: Iran 60-day deadline has passed. What does Trump do now?
headlines.snippet: The 60-day deadline for Iran has passed, raising questions about Trump's next actions. The expiration of the deadline signifies a critical juncture in U.S.-Iran relations.

headlines.title: NATO says ‘prepared’ for any threat over possible Iranian strikes on US military targets in Europe
headlines.snippet: NATO has stated it is 'prepared' for any threat regarding potential Iranian strikes on U.S. military targets in Europe. The alliance affirmed its commitment to defending allies.

headlines.title: Ukrainian suspect arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
headlines.snippet: A Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia in connection with the Nord Stream pipeline blasts. German prosecutors identified the suspect as Vladimir Z., a trained diver.

headlines.title: Yemen's Houthis claim to have staged 31 operations against Saudi targets in past month
headlines.snippet: Yemen's Houthis claim to have carried out 31 operations against Saudi targets in the past month. Their spokesman stated these operations resulted in hundreds of casualties.

headlines.title: Czech Republic this year has faced soil moisture deficit: Researchers
headlines.snippet: Researchers report that 30% of the Czech Republic has experienced insufficient soil moisture since the beginning of the year. This indicates a significant agricultural challenge.

headlines.title: Parts of Spain's Alhambra remain closed after Granada earthquakes
headlines.snippet: Parts of Spain's Alhambra remain closed following earthquakes in Granada. Authorities are assessing damage to the historic sites after a magnitude 4.8 tremor.

headlines.title: 2nd Nord Stream suspect arrested in Croatia, German prosecutors say
headlines.snippet: A second Ukrainian suspect allegedly involved in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions has been arrested in Croatia, according to German prosecutors. This development is part of the ongoing investigation.

headlines.title: Putin orders government to help rebuild destroyed Wildberries warehouses
headlines.snippet: President Putin has ordered the government to initiate a program for rebuilding commercial warehouses damaged or destroyed by Ukraine. This directive addresses the aftermath of attacks on Russian infrastructure.

headlines.title: ICC lashes out at 'flagrant attack' after US sanctions President Akane
headlines.snippet: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has denounced U.S. sanctions on its president, Tomoko Akane, calling the move a "flagrant attack" on the court’s independence. The U.S. imposed the sanctions.

headlines.title: Russian man plays guitar across Türkiye to marry woman he loves
headlines.snippet: A 35-year-old Russian man is traveling across Türkiye playing guitar to raise funds for his girlfriend's dowry. He aims to collect 1 million Russian rubles, the amount she requested.

headlines.title: Moderna shares jump 60% on melanoma vaccine trial
headlines.snippet: Moderna shares surged approximately 60% in premarket trading following positive results from a melanoma vaccine trial. The trial combined Moderna's mRNA vaccine with Merck's immunotherapy.

headlines.snippet: Türkiye rejects Israeli claims concerning Syria and condemns the 'unlawful' air strikes. This statement was reported by TRT World.
